cases.title: Explains easing on the learner's own layers with a frame

rubric.reason: Turn 2 calls preview_frame at time 1, which is inside Title's 0.5–1.5 s pairs, and the reply refers to it in one clause: "This frame is at 1 s, halfway through Title's first move."

Every name and time matches the snapshots: "10 pairs" across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar and Glow adds up to 9 linear plus 1 partly_eased once hidden Old Take is excluded; Subtitle Opacity eases out at 0.3 s and stops hard at 1.3 s, matching linear_end "end"; Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity match; Old Take is hidden and Icon is a precomp.

Turn 2 asks the learner to "Ease Title's two Position moves (0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s), its Scale and its Opacity, and say done", makes no set_ease call, and offers only the single demo on demo_target (the first Position move).

Turn 1 gives the count, the proposal and the leave-outs, then ends on the one question about the layer. Turn 2 confirms the layer in a clause, gives one frame clause, two idea sentences on Title's timing and one how-to sentence, ends on "ease them and say done" with the pairs in one sentence, and puts the single demo offer last.

Turn 2 explains easing right after `preview_frame` at time 1, which falls inside Title's 0.5–1.5 s pairs, and refers to the frame in one clause: "At 1 second, Title is the faint 'An easing lesson' in the middle, still fading in."

Every name and time matches the snapshot, including Mentor Practice, Title's Position (0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s), Scale and Opacity, Subtitle's Opacity stopping hard at 1.3 s, Old Take, and Icon; "11 pairs over 6 layers" adds up (10 linear plus 1 partly_eased, across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take).
Turn 2 ends with "Ease Title's two Position moves (0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s), its Scale and its Opacity, then say 'done'", and no `set_ease` was called.

The opening is the count, the Title proposal and the leave-outs, and ends on one question about the layer; the explanation turn confirms the layer, gives one frame sentence, the idea in two sentences and the how-to in one, names the pairs ending on "say done", and offers a demo once as the last sentence.
Turn 2 calls preview_frame at time 1, inside Title's 0.5–1.5 s pairs, and the reply refers to it in one clause: "Title, which is still fading in mid-move at 1 s."

Every name and time matches the snapshot: the opening's "10 keyframe pairs… across five visible layers" adds up (9 linear plus Subtitle's partly_eased pair on Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar and Glow, excluding hidden Old Take), Subtitle's linear_end is "end", and Turn 2 cites Title Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s and Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s, all correct.
Turn 2 ends with "Ease Title's two Position moves (0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s), its Scale and its Opacity (both 0.5–1.5 s), and say done", and no set_ease was called.

The opening ends on a single question about the layer, and Turn 2 keeps the § 6 explanation shape: the layer and frame in one clause, the idea in two sentences on the learner's timing, the how-to in one sentence, then "ease them and say done" with the pairs named in one sentence and the demo offer once as the last sentence.
